pages.text: $(item)Pureblood$() are natural $(heartless)heartless$() and have a weak will. They are born when a somebody's $(thing)heart$() is swallowed by $(lissa)darkness$(). Unlike $(emblem)Emblem-Heartless$(), these do not release $(thing)hearts$(), once defeated.$(p)Usually they are black with yellow eyes, but become more colorful the stronger they are.
